title: Pagination skips the first page of results

issue.title: GET /articles?page=1 does not return the first articles
issue.body: Requesting page 1 returns articles starting at id 11 instead of id 1, so the first page of results is unreachable. The last page also returns fewer items than it should. Pages are 1-indexed.
issue.repro_steps: GET /articles?page=1&size=10 and observe the first item has id 11.
issue.expected_behavior: Page 1 returns articles 1-10, page 2 returns 11-20, page 3 returns 21-25.

expected_root_cause: ArticleStore.page computes offset as page * size, but pages are 1-indexed, so it should be (page - 1) * size.
